panels.description: Persistent personal battle outcomes from the battle ledger.
panels.title: Personal battles · total

panels.description: External unique players captured after V20. Opening the bot before /start is not measurable. Registration is the sample size; n < 30 is descriptive only. Optional daily/shop/replay/front branches are excluded.
panels.title: Activation funnel · unique players

panels.description: Two explicit denominators: all captured external registrations and players who selected a country. Repeated callbacks for the same battle ID count once.
panels.title: Activation conversion · two denominators

panels.description: Time from captured registration to the first distinct battle_started. Players without a first battle are excluded from the quantiles.
panels.title: TTFB · first battle

panels.description: Never started uses registrations. The two repeat windows remain separate: 24h after first finish and 24h after registration.
panels.title: Never started and repeat

panels.description: Exact [k×24h,(k+1)×24h) user-action retention. Immature players are excluded; each day also shows its matured denominator n.
panels.title: D1 / D3 / D7 and maturity

panels.description: Observed last activation stage and nearby bounded technical context. A 30-minute session end is not proof of churn or its cause.
panels.title: Observed stopping points

panels.description: First and latest external journey event retained in PostgreSQL. Detailed cohort cuts live in docs/analytics/activation-retention.sql.
panels.title: Event coverage

panels.description: External-player recommendation delivery, explicit primary-button click and completed next step. Completion means a distinct later battle finished or a clicked restoration produced a battle-ready group.
panels.title: Primary action · sent / clicked / completed

panels.description: Explicit details opens divided by Telegram-confirmed compact result deliveries. Telegram exposes no passive message read receipt.
panels.title: Result details open ratio

panels.description: Distinct external players observed blocked, restored, and starting a later battle in the same session or within 24 hours.
panels.title: Army recovery · blocked to next battle

panels.description: Elapsed time from the first observed recovery blocker to a battle-ready group for external players.
panels.title: Army recovery time

panels.description: External navigation errors by bounded category and current player stage. Raw text and command values are never labels.
panels.title: Navigation errors by stage

panels.description: Distinct external players with a navigation error, a later successful action in the same session, or repeated navigation errors.
panels.title: Navigation recovery in session

panels.description: Distinct external players shown the personal-to-weekly bridge, clicking it, committing or withdrawing a first contribution, returning in a later session, and hitting the personal-battle reservation guardrail.
panels.title: Personal battle → weekly front bridge

panels.description: End-to-end stage latency for external battle and replay attempts. Ready means the artifact exists; delivered means Telegram accepted sendAnimation.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, operation, mode, stage, cache) (rate(frontline_technical_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",result="success"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, operation, mode, stage, cache) (rate(frontline_technical_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",result="success"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, operation, mode, stage, cache) (rate(frontline_technical_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",result="success"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Battle and replay stage latency

panels.description: Failed or unknown stage attempts divided by all attempts at the same stage. Failure classes are bounded server-side.

targets.expr: sum by (operation, mode, stage) (increase(frontline_technical_stage_total{job=~"$job",result!="success"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (operation, mode, stage) (increase(frontline_technical_stage_total{job=~"$job"}[$__range])), 1)

panels.title: Technical failure ratio

panels.description: Successful replay artifacts by cold render or cache hit. This measures readiness, not whether the player watched the video.
panels.title: Replay ready · cold vs cache

panels.description: Telegram-accepted replay deliveries divided by replay requests. Telegram does not expose a reliable watch event.
panels.title: Replay delivery ratio

panels.description: Durable replay jobs waiting, rendering, or ready for Telegram delivery, plus the bounded one-thread worker state.
panels.title: Replay worker pressure

panels.description: Process CPU utilization while replay rendering is serialized to one worker.
panels.title: Process CPU

panels.description: HTTP request throughput by route and status.
panels.title: HTTP requests

panels.description: Server responses with status 5xx during the selected dashboard range.
panels.title: HTTP 5xx

panels.description: Maximum JVM heap currently in use by the selected instance.
panels.title: JVM heap used
